screens.title: Feel at home in the gym
screens.body: Tell us a little about you and we'll build a plan that fits your goals, your week and how you feel about the gym.

screens.title: How old are you?
screens.why_we_ask: Ascenda is designed for adults, and it helps us pitch your plan at the right pace.
screens.privacy_note: We only store an age range, never your date of birth.

under_18.inline_message: Our plans are designed for people aged 18 and over, so we can't set you up just yet. A PE teacher or a qualified coach at your local leisure centre can help you get started safely.

screens.note_for_dev: Asked before any other personal data. If Under 18 is selected: show the inline message below the options, keep Continue disabled, store nothing and send no analytics events with answers. She can change her selection (for mis-taps), but never show 'are you sure?' or any hint about changing it.

screens.title: What should we call you?
What would you love to achieve?
screens.helper: Pick up to 3. Your first pick is your main goal.

options.label: Get back into training after a break

screens.limit_hint: You can pick up to 3. Tap one to swap it out.

screens.title: Great choices, {name}

body_by_main_goal.build_strength: Strength builds faster than most people expect. Many beginners add weight to their main lifts week after week for the first few months.
body_by_main_goal.build_muscle: Building muscle comes from lifting challenging weights consistently. Your plan will tell you exactly when to go heavier.
body_by_main_goal.glutes_and_legs: Your glutes respond best to being trained from a few different angles each week. We'll build that into your plan.
body_by_main_goal.upper_body_strength: A strong back and shoulders help you lift more and stand taller. We'll give you plenty of pulling as well as pushing.
body_by_main_goal.feel_toned: Feeling toned mostly comes from building a bit of muscle. Strength training is the most reliable way to get there.
body_by_main_goal.gym_confidence: You're far from alone. We'll start you somewhere comfortable and add a little more of the gym at your own pace.
body_by_main_goal.fitness_stamina: Strength training and cardio work brilliantly together. We'll keep your sessions moving.
body_by_main_goal.mobility: Moving well and getting strong go hand in hand. Every session starts and ends with mobility work.
body_by_main_goal.better_posture: A stronger upper back is one of the best things for posture. We'll make sure your plan includes it.
body_by_main_goal.more_energy: Regular strength training is a great way to feel more energetic day to day. Consistency matters more than intensity.
body_by_main_goal.stress_relief: Lots of women say the gym is the one hour that's just for them. We'll keep your plan simple so it never feels like another job.
body_by_main_goal.strong_for_life: Strength training is one of the best things you can do for strong bones, joints and balance as you get older.
body_by_main_goal.back_to_training: Coming back is easier than starting. Your body remembers more than you think.
body_by_main_goal.lose_body_fat: Building strength is a great foundation for changing your body composition. We'll focus on getting you strong and consistent.

screens.title: How long have you been going to the gym?

options.label: On and off over the years

screens.title: How do you feel when you're in the gym?
"I'm not sure what to do when I get to the gym"
"I feel like people are watching me"
You're not alone

stat.text: of UK women surveyed said they'd felt some form of anxiety in the gym.

stat.source_note: Show the source line under the stat.

screens.body: That's why every exercise in Ascenda comes with a first-time guide: where to find it, how to set it up and what to do if it's taken. You can start in one quiet spot and add more of the gym when you're ready.
screens.alt_body: Every exercise comes with a first-time guide and quick swaps for when the gym is busy, so your session never stalls.

screens.title: "I find it hard to stay motivated on my own"
"I've started and stopped before"
"My gym is usually busy when I can go"
Plans beat willpower
screens.body: Deciding when and where you'll train makes it much more likely you'll actually go. You'll pick your days in a moment, and we'll remind you before each session.

extra_if.st_stopped>=3: And if life gets in the way, that's normal. Ascenda gives you rest weeks and an easy way back in, so a missed week never means starting over.

screens.title: Which of these have you used before?
screens.helper: Tap any you've tried. It's fine if it's none yet.
screens.note_for_dev: Feeds the Gym unlocked baseline: these count as already tried, but don't award first-time badges for them.

screens.title: How do you feel about cardio?

options.label: I'd avoid it if I could

screens.helper: No wrong answer. It just tells us how much cardio to add to your week.

screens.title: How many days a week can you train?
screens.helper: Pick what's realistic on a normal week. You can always do more.

screens.title: Which days work best?
screens.helper: Pick {days_per_week} days. We'll space them out if we can.

screens.title: How long do you have for each session?
How many weeks would you like to aim for first?
screens.helper: A week counts when you train at least once. It's a milestone, not a test.

screens.title: When would you like a nudge on training days?
screens.helper: We'll ask for permission to send reminders after your first session.

screens.title: Would you like to add your bodyweight?
screens.why_we_ask: Only used for your own strength stats, like lifting your bodyweight on the leg press. It's never used to predict anything, never shared and you can delete it any time.

why_lines.text: It starts in one quiet spot, so you can settle in at your own pace.
Cardio is kept to one short, skippable finisher a week.
Your week includes cardio days alongside your lifting.
Every session tells you exactly what to do, with a guide for every exercise.
Every exercise has quick swaps for when the gym is busy.
It fits your {days_per_week} days a week.

why_lines.if: main_goal == routine.goal or main_goal in routine.secondary_goals
why_lines.text: It's built around your main goal: {main_goal_label}.
It has a clear finish line, so you always know what you're working towards.
Checkpoints and wins after every session help you see your progress.
It's progressive enough to keep you getting stronger.

recommendation._how: Evaluate rules top to bottom; the first match is the recommendation. Then pick 2 alternatives: the next two matching rules that give different routines, falling back to the alternatives listed on the chosen rule.

rules.if: gym_experience in ['not_yet','just_started'] and main_goal == 'glutes_and_legs' and gym_comfort >= 3
gym_experience in ['not_yet','just_started'] and main_goal == 'upper_body_strength' and gym_comfort >= 3
main_goal == 'fitness_stamina' and cardio_preference != 'avoid' and gym_experience in ['on_and_off','regularly'] and days_per_week == 2

_notes: Summit is only shown in alternatives when gym_experience == 'regularly' and gym_comfort == 5, or when she browses.
If a recommended routine needs more days than she picked, it's still allowed only when the difference is 1 and the Planner can fit it; otherwise skip that rule.

strength_estimate._purpose: Real, conservative calculation for the plan reveal timeline. Never hard-coded, never shown as a promise.
strength_estimate.lift: the first checkpoint lift of the recommended routine
strength_estimate.exposures: number of sessions in the routine that include this lift (count across all weeks, excluding lighter weeks)
strength_estimate.assumption: She adds weight roughly every third time she does the lift, which is conservative for beginners using double progression.
strength_estimate.display: About +{estimated_increase_kg} kg on your {lift_name} by week {routine.length_weeks}
strength_estimate.hide_if: estimated_increase_kg < 2 or the lift is bodyweight or machine-based without a kg increment
strength_estimate.first_estimate: On insight_goals, use the default routine for her experience level (strong-foundations-6-weeks for beginners, the-climb-in-8-weeks otherwise) and its first milestone. After building_plan, recalculate with the recommended routine. The result can move earlier or later.
